goal: Standardize complete-stack working outputs with concrete generation mechanisms: parametric CAD-like geometry, machine-readable system landscapes, math models, programs, schematics, BOMs, and test/measurement artifacts. Every generated output must retain canonical-source, check, witness-depth, and provenance lineage so it can become valid input to later traversal.
next_movement: Apply the output layer on the first integrated physical-system target. For geometry: parameters/evidence → CadQuery by default (OpenSCAD when simpler) → STEP/STL/DXF/SVG → geometry checks → derived values. For system landscapes: named referents/relations → Graphviz/DOT → SVG/PDF/PNG → graph checks. Feed derived outputs into math/program/schematic/BOM artifacts and propagate invalidation when upstream parameters or evidence change.
walls: Do not redefine A/B as Complete Stack, this repository, a workflow, or an implementation layer.
Do not stop traversal merely because a required dependency belongs to another discipline.
Do not upgrade a digital placeholder, model, simulation, or design into a physical witness.
Do not let résumé categories select development.
Do not reopen the program foundation unless a real incoming problem exposes a missing relation.
